description: Ygnacio Plaza is a proven neighborhood shopping center strategically located at 1881 Ygnacio Valley Road in Walnut Creek, California, positioned along a major city thoroughfare that ensures excellent visibility and accessibility. Spanning 109,701 square feet, this well-established community center serves one of the Bay Area's most affluent markets, with surrounding households averaging $188,295 in income and home values exceeding $1.2 million. The center is anchored by popular retailers including Sports Basement and TJ Maxx, providing a compelling mix of sporting goods, off-price fashion, and complementary services that drive over 2.4 million annual visits. With strong daytime business supported by a robust daytime population of 143,197 within three miles, Ygnacio Plaza benefits from both residential shoppers and nearby office workers seeking convenient retail options. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, the property maintains high standards and continues to serve as a vital retail destination in the thriving San Francisco-Oakland-Fremont metropolitan market.
